name: open-qr-link-card
description: A printable card whose permanent QR code shows different links depending on who is looking: public, temporary or approved-follower. Static, dependency-free, MIT.

scripts.test: node --test tests/access.test.js tests/qr.test.js tests/card.test.js tests/generator.test.js tests/dom.test.js

comments.dependencies: Deliberately empty. The site is plain HTML/CSS/JS and must stay that way — see CONTRIBUTING.md. Some tests compare our output against independent implementations (qrcode, jsqr, pdfjs-dist, @napi-rs/canvas, jsdom); they are looked for OUTSIDE the repo, see tests/oracle.js.
comments.test: Runs the five suites explicitly rather than the directory, because `node --test tests/` trips over module resolution in some Node versions. Suites that need the dev-only oracles skip with an install hint when they are missing, so this works on a fresh clone; install them (CONTRIBUTING.md#the-dev-only-oracles) to get the full 126.
comments.test:core: The tier/token/follower rules — no external packages needed at all.
